episodes.title: Approachable Dreams
episodes.summary: Debra Newell has a seemingly perfect life: she's successful, beautiful and lives in one of California's most desirable coastal cities, Newport Beach. The only thing missing is love. So when Debra finally meets charming and handsome doctor John Meehan, she's quickly swept into a whirlwind romance, much to her daughters' dismay.

episodes.title: Red Flags and Parades
episodes.summary: Debra and John revel secretly in their newlywed bliss, as Veronica, Terra, and Toby hatch a plan to prove their suspicions about their mother's new man.

episodes.title: Remember It Was Me
episodes.summary: Debra discovers John's criminal record. In the past, John starts his first family.

episodes.title: Shrapnel
episodes.summary: Debra confronts John; Arlane's past is revealed.

episodes.title: Lord High Executioner
episodes.summary: John gets clean for Debra. Terra learns John's back. John puts his sister through the ringer.

episodes.title: One Shoe
episodes.summary: Debra makes a decision about John. In Ohio, John captures the attention of Detective Dennis Luken.

episodes.title: Chivalry
episodes.summary: An inside look into how John operates while Debra tries to move forward.

episodes.title: This Young Woman Fought Like Hell
episodes.summary: John and Debra's relationship comes to a head in an unexpected way.

episodes.title: No Fault
episodes.summary: Betty thinks she can't be divorced by her rich lawyer husband Dan without her consent. She's wrong.

episodes.title: The Turtle and the Alligator
episodes.summary: Through medical school, law school and many pregnancies, Betty supports Dan until he hits it big.

episodes.title: Marriage Encounter
episodes.summary: A worried Betty takes a desperate step to save her marriage, and it works. Until it doesn't.

episodes.title: More to It Than Fun
episodes.summary: Dan gaslights Betty until the truth comes out and she sees her life has been a sham for years.

episodes.title: Scream Therapy
episodes.summary: Fighting her new reality, Betty goes on the offense, hurting everyone-but most of all, herself.

episodes.title: The Twelfth of Never
episodes.summary: Betty faces Dan in divorce court, and it sends her past a point of no return.

episodes.title: The Shillelagh
episodes.summary: Having lost her sense of identity, Betty can only see her own pain - and turn it outward.

episodes.title: Perception is Reality
episodes.summary: Empathy from strangers allows Betty to avoid facing what she's done, until she can't any more.
